The '''Secure Passage seminar''' was held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dlor 3]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sisquoc]] planned to confront [[Barosa Warren]] at the seminar.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
